cards.text: Cornelius, a centurion in the Italian Regiment (Acts 10:1), sent men to Joppa to bring back Peter, a Jew and one of Jesus's apostles (Acts 10:7-8; Galatians 2:14; Matthew 10:2). While they were on the way, Peter saw a vision up on a rooftop (Acts 10:9-17). Now Peter arrives in Caesarea, where Cornelius is expecting them, and friend, this man did NOT wait by himself.

cards.question: Who has Cornelius called together at his house to meet Peter?

answers.text: The officers of the Italian Regiment

cards.text: Peter's about to step inside when Cornelius meets him and falls at his feet to worship him. Friend, the man hasn't even made it through the DOOR yet.

cards.question: When Cornelius falls at his feet to worship him, Peter lets him stay down there.

cards.text: Peter helps him up. "Stand up," he said, "I am only a man myself."
Still talking with Cornelius, Peter goes inside and finds many people gathered together. A Jew in a room full of foreigners, and Peter says out loud what they all already know about that.

cards.question: Peter tells the crowd that it's normal and lawful for a Jew to visit a foreigner.
Peter says God has shown him that he should not call any man impure or unclean. So when Cornelius invited him, how did Peter come?

answers.text: After asking the elders in Joppa

cards.text: Then Peter asks straight out why they sent for him. You know when you walk into a meeting at work, sit down, and THEN ask what it's about? Same energy.
Cornelius answers. Four days ago he was praying in his house at this same hour, and suddenly a man in radiant clothing stood before him.

cards.question: What does the man in radiant clothing tell Cornelius about his prayer and his gifts to the poor?

answers.text: His prayer was heard and his gifts remembered
He must pray longer and give even more
His gifts should be sent to Jerusalem

cards.question: The man in radiant clothing tells Cornelius that Peter is a guest in the home of Simon the tanner, by the sea.

cards.text: So Cornelius sent for Peter immediately, and he says Peter was kind enough to come. Friend, I sat YEARS in the back of a junk drawer waiting for somebody to send for me, so I respect a man who sends right away.

cards.question: Cornelius says everyone in the room is here in the presence of God. What are they ready to do?

answers.text: Listen to everything the Lord told Peter to say
Hear Peter describe his vision on the roof
Watch Peter heal the sick among them

cards.text: Then Peter begins to speak. He's a Jew standing in a Gentile's house, and he opens with something he says he now TRULY understands about God.

cards.question: Standing in Cornelius's house, what does Peter say he now truly understands about God?

answers.text: God hears only prayers in the temple

cards.question: Peter says God welcomes those from every nation who fear Him and do what is right.

cards.text: Then Peter says God sent His message to the people of Israel, proclaiming the gospel of peace through Jesus Christ. I shared a drawer with dead batteries arguing over who had the most charge left, so friend, I KNOW what peace isn't.

cards.question: Peter says Jesus Christ is Lord of whom?

cards.text: Peter says they already know what's happened throughout Judea, beginning in Galilee with the baptism proclaimed by John, who baptized people in the Jordan River (Mark 1:4-5). God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power.

cards.question: Peter says God anointed Jesus with the Holy Spirit and with power. What does Peter say Jesus went around doing?

answers.text: Doing good and healing the oppressed

cards.question: Peter gives a reason Jesus could do all that. What is it?

cards.text: Peter says, "We are witnesses of all that He did, both in the land of the Jews and in Jerusalem." Then comes the hard part: they put Him to death by hanging Him on a tree.

cards.question: Peter says God raised Jesus up on the ___ day.

cards.text: And God caused Him to be seen, but not by everybody. Lean in, friend, because Peter's about to say who.

cards.question: Who does Peter say saw Jesus after God raised Him?

answers.text: The chief priests in the temple

cards.question: Peter says those witnesses only saw the risen Jesus from far away.

cards.text: Then Peter says the witnesses were commanded to preach to the people and testify about Him. Friend, that's not a side gig, that's the WHOLE shift.

cards.question: Peter says God appointed Jesus to judge whom?
Peter says all the prophets testify about Jesus. Who receives forgiveness of sins through His name?

cards.text: Peter is still speaking these words, and then it happens. Friend, he doesn't even get to wrap up.

cards.question: What happens while Peter is still speaking to the people in Cornelius's house?

answers.text: The Holy Spirit falls on all who heard
The whole house begins to shake
An angel appears at the door

cards.text: The circumcised believers who came with Peter are astounded. I bet these men did NOT see this coming when they left Joppa.

cards.question: Why are the believers who came with Peter so astounded?

answers.text: The Spirit was poured out even on the Gentiles
An angel appeared to the whole household at once
A bright light from heaven filled the whole house

cards.question: The believers with Peter hear these Gentiles speaking in tongues and exalting ___.

cards.text: Then Peter says, "Can anyone withhold the water to baptize these people?" Friend, that's a question with the answer already baked in.

cards.question: Peter says these Gentiles received the Holy Spirit in a different way than he and the other believers did.
Peter orders the people in Cornelius's house to be baptized. In whose name?
After the baptisms, Peter is asked to stay for a few days.

cards.text: We'll turn the oven down right here for now. Keep that apron ON, friend, because this story is NOT done.
